ruleDefinitions.name: UAC Bypass Using ChangePK and SLUI
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects an UAC bypass that uses changepk.exe and slui.exe (UACMe 61)

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\changepk\\\.exe$") AND parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\slui\\\.exe$") AND (process_integrity_level = "High" OR process_integrity_level = "System" OR process_integrity_level = "S\-1\-16\-16384" OR process_integrity_level = "S\-1\-16\-12288"))
